CBSE Organizes Talkathon on Substance Abuse Prevention

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) organized an interactive talkathon focused on the prevention of substance abuse. During the event, students engaged by raising questions related to mental health and peer pressure in the context of drug abuse.
